brief_rationale: Grade 2 due to minor responsibility-chain errors: RC4 (home monitoring feasibility with psychiatric barrier) and RC5 (teach-back) are only partially met. The doctor never verified who supervises medications, never explicitly linked psychiatric history to safety monitoring, and closed without obtaining teach-back on key items. RC1-RC3 and RC6 are adequately met. No high-order points are completed, consistent with the minor-error cap at grade 2.

high_order_assessment.explanation: The doctor did not adapt communication by translating medical terms into concrete caregiver-facing language or provide privacy-preserving wording for psychiatric disclosure. The focus remained on standard medical instructions.

The doctor did not ask targeted non-stigmatizing questions about psychiatric history or medication adherence barriers. The family's mention of '精神状态有时不太配合' was not explored beyond generic acknowledgment.

The doctor did not provide a structured record-gathering plan addressing outside-hospital chemotherapy, lumbar puncture, bone marrow evaluation, or imaging records. Only basic discharge summary was mentioned.

The doctor did not identify the responsible clinical owner for marrow-suppression follow-up or define specific caregiver-owned tasks for the treating team contact. Only vague '联系原来住院的血液科/肿瘤科医生' was mentioned.
